question.text: In evaluating the 'Investment Management Team and Infrastructure' dimension of fund DD, the Manager's LP-facing pack should demonstrate:

answer.text: Only the CV of the Managing Partner — since other team members are fungible.

Team skill-set, analytical resources (macro/equity/credit), organisational structure, staffing adequacy, compensation structure, the management-company chart, and team-member tenure and remuneration details.
Only the Chief Investment Officer's IRR track-record from prior roles.
Only the number of CFA charterholders on staff, as SEBI requires a minimum count.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 12, investor DD on the investment management team covers team quality, analytical resources, organisational structure, staffing adequacy and compensation structure, supplemented by the management-company chart and team-member tenure and remuneration details. The Trap: Options A and C ignore team depth and structure — both of which are explicit DD focus areas. Option D fabricates a SEBI CFA-headcount requirement. Note: The workbook treats the team and infrastructure assessment as a multi-element review and expects all of these elements to be inspected together.
